context: Naoko explains a regional dish to a new tourist customer.
purpose: Aunt warmly explaining Kansai food to visitor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おばさん、定食、いただきます。
lines.en: Thank you, auntie — I'll dig in.
lines.style: Soft, careful politeness. Warm gratitude on the opening. Slight pause before the set meal, like he's gathering himself to be respectful. Quiet and genuine.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おう、関西の伝統、味わってや!
lines.en: Go on — taste the real Kansai tradition!
lines.style: Bright, generous energy. Chest-forward pride. Quick rhythm, almost musical. The confidence of someone who knows what she's serving is good. Warmth without hesitation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 味付け、濃い感じ、しますね。
lines.en: The seasoning is really rich, isn't it.
lines.style: Noticing, almost to himself. Soft tone with a gentle rise of appreciation at the end. Speaking carefully, like he's tasting and talking at once. Sincere, not performing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 地方によって、味、違うで、皆。
lines.en: Flavors change by region, you know. Everyone's different.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. Settling back into herself, sharing something she knows well. Steady rhythm, teaching without lecturing. A small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 皮、丁寧に作ってますね。
lines.en: The texture of it — you can tell it's made with real care.
lines.style: Admiring and precise. He's caught something genuine in the food and wants to name it right. Soft voice, focused. A moment of real connection through noticing.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ようけ、毎日、ええもん作っとる!
lines.en: Every day you make something this good — it's no wonder!
lines.style: Bright, spirited declaration. Forward energy. Pride in her own work, letting it show. Generous and unbothered by modesty. Pure affection in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、本当にうまい!
lines.en: Really, thank you — this is genuinely delicious.
lines.style: Humble, sincere gratitude. Slow and warm. A full bow in the voice without overdoing it. He means it, and he wants her to know it lands.
